translation: In the Udu or Vimshottari scheme the dasha years are 6, 10, 7, 18, 16, 19, 17, 7, and 20, following the standard planetary order from Sun through Venus.
context_before: The 30th chapter ends and Chapter 31 begins the dedicated Vimshottari discussion.
context_after: The note attached to the opening verses discusses variants for choosing the opening dasha when Lagna is stronger than the Moon.
notes: The passage is used for order and year-allocation support only.
